cassia.predicted_cell_type: Cycling Neural Progenitor Cells (NPCs), specifically of dorsal telencephalic lineage.
strengths: Correctly prioritizes the dominant proliferative/DNA-replication program (PCLAF, MCM genes, PCNA, TYMS, RRM2)
Correctly recognizes neural progenitor markers SOX2, SOX3, FABP7, PTN and adds GLI3 dorsal telencephalic context
weaknesses: Label is unmapped and cannot be assigned a frozen ontology ID
Adds oRG/dorsal telencephalic specificity beyond what the frozen ontology context can validate; proliferation genes alone are not lineage-specific

strengths: Broad neural lineage is consistent with the presence of SOX2/SOX3 and absence of mature non-neural markers
Provides a valid mapped ontology ID
weaknesses: Too broad: does not capture the neural progenitor/radial glia markers (FABP7, PTN, ID4, TTYH1, SFRP1) in its top1 label
The frozen ontology treats neural cell and neural progenitor cell as non-hierarchical, so the more specific NPC label is strongly favored

strengths: Directly supported by SOX2, SOX3, FABP7, PTN plus absence of mature neuronal/oligodendrocyte/microglial markers
Appropriate specificity for the original DEG evidence
weaknesses: Does not encode the prominent cycling/S-phase state in the label, but this is a transient cell state rather than a distinct lineage

supporting: Neural progenitor identity supported by SOX2, SOX3, FABP7, PTN, ID4, TTYH1, SFRP1 in the original cluster markers.
Cycling/S-phase state supported by PCLAF, PCNA, MCM3/MCM4/MCM7, TYMS, RRM2, GINS2, CDT1, ORC6, CENPK, NUSAP1.
GLI3, ID4, FABP7 provide a dorsal telencephalic/radial glia-like context consistent with, but not required for, the neural progenitor cell assignment.
Absence of mature lineage markers (e.g., SYT1, RBFOX3, MBP, PLP1, AIF1, CX3CR1) in the top DEGs is consistent with a neural progenitor rather than differentiated state.
conflicting: Frozen ontology context treats neural cell (CL:0002319) and neural progenitor cell (CL:0011020) as non-hierarchical; progenitor-specific markers resolve this branch in favor of neural progenitor cell.
CASSIA's dorsal radial glia/oRG-specific label is unmapped and adds components not fully supported by the frozen ontology.
enrichment_or_literature: Original bioinformatics enrichment of DNA replication and G1/S/S-phase pathways is consistent with the cycling state; no PMID evidence was provided.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
